name: Dark Digivice
effect: Once between rests, you may force your partner Digimon to dark digivolve one stage higher than the highest stage it could otherwise reach this encounter, even without an unlocked line for that stage. No roll is needed, it enters a dark form immediately, chosen by the GM as normal for Dark Digivolution. When this dark form ends and your Digimon reverts, its HP drops to 1 and its Default Stage permanently decreases by 1.
